::: {#lem-rss-hessian}
#### Second derivatives of RSS

The matrix of second derivatives of
$\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to $\intcoef$ and $\coef{x}$ is positive definite
at every $(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ when $\sspred > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
and equals

$$\begin{pmatrix} 2n & 2 n \predbar \\ 2 n \predbar & 2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}.$$
:::

::: proof

The matrix of second derivatives is the solution to @exr-rss-hessian.
The positive definiteness is the solution to @exr-rss-hessian-positive-definite.

:::
